Overview.Name: Aaina Suresh Namdev
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & potato or carrot curry + curd
Option 2: Curd rice (150 g rice + curd) & paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & paneer bhurji (100 g)
Meal_2 (Dinner - lighter): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid green vegetables as per your preference but include other vegetables like carrot and potato.
Start meals with paneer or curd before eating rice to control portions.
For boredom eating, drink buttermilk or water and wait 10 minutes before eating more.
Keep dinner lighter to support fat loss and better digestion.
Simple and consistent meals will improve body shape and energy levels.
Get sunlight exposure in the morning which will improve your sleep and improving sleep will significantly improve energy and control cravings.
